runtimeScope: Same client and actor. Group/UI/Notes were unloaded at preflight and loaded from the installed 1.1.0 files during the baseline. Existing UI edits are retained. No production patch or reload performed during this investigation.
units: WoW counters in KB. Decimal MB = KB * 1024 / 1000000. Method heap deltas are inclusive, can overlap and are not cumulative allocations.

findings.primaryPath: Search.OnResultsUpdated -> Results.QueueUpdate -> FlushUpdates -> CommitResults -> Normalize -> C_LFGList.GetSearchResultInfo
findings.originalPerOperationStats: The bulk and result-update cases measure enqueue work, not the deferred flush. Multiple events in one tick coalesce; event counts cannot be multiplied by result count to estimate getter calls.
findings.conclusion: Repeated bulk native-result reads produce short-lived tables and are sufficient to exceed the 20 MB target. Stable UI and detail-cache hits do not prevent this peak. Passive observation did not reproduce the pressure peak.
findings.limitation: The profile run had natural GC during measured methods. Do not interpret its lower peak as an optimization or sum nested method deltas. Native UI bytes and unobserved intra-call peaks remain unattributed. Event guarantees needed for an equivalent incremental production fix are not established.
